subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract and security/fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class chat video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/LLM/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding only
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported `infer video describe` and media-understanding paths instead.

options.title: Narrow to provider-specific plugins first
options.body: Let providers prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class chat video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/LLM/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest visible combination of issue-routing context, current-line ownership signal, and adjacent video/media-understanding history.
